A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Before we build.

Custom software or an existing solution?

Start with your workflow. Adapting an existing solution can be a useful starting point. A custom build may be a better fit for unique processes or specific integrations. We’ll discuss both routes with you.

Can you help if I only have an idea?

Yes. Share the problem you want to solve, who the software is for, and what you want it to achieve. That gives us a starting point for discovery and scope.

How much will a project cost?

Cost depends on scope, integrations, and customization. Send us a brief and we’ll discuss requirements before proposing a cost and timeline.

Can you work with tools we already use?

Tell us which systems you use and what needs to connect. We’ll review the integration options and confirm what is feasible during scoping.
